text: BAM share rose 0.21 percentage points over 25 hours and 0.77 percentage points over 7 days, bringing BAM share to 37.6%. Concentration remains elevated: the largest node holds 21.9% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 4. The 68 top-node leadership changes in this window are best read as whale-driven routing, not a structural rollover.
